responsibility: Provides the Xtensa uClinux subtarget configuration for the GCC driver and target macros. It adds the __uClinux__ builtin, defines the user-space CPP spec and type sizes, sets assembler and linker specs around elf2flt-based linking, keeps PIC disabled by default unlike Linux, and adjusts libc capability reporting, thereby specializing the generic Xtensa backend for uClinux/flat-binary environments.
same_name_distinction: Pairs with uclinux.opt as the uClinux subtarget header that actually changes target macros and specs—such as __uClinux__ builtins, type sizes, and LINK_SPEC defaulting to -elf2flt—whereas uclinux.opt only declares the elf2flt command-line options referenced by that spec.
